definitions: An instrument for drawing circles and arcs and for measuring distances, consisting of two arms linked by a hinge, one arm ending in a sharp point and the other in a pencil or pen.
A V-shaped instrument with two pointed arms, used for taking measurements and transferring them.
examples: He used a pair of compasses to draw a perfect circle.
The architect measured the distance with a pair of compasses.
She needed a pair of compasses for her geometry class.
